semiconductor_relevance: High — PerkinElmer provides advanced measurement and testing solutions specifically tailored for the semiconductor industry.
summary: PerkinElmer Management (Shanghai) Co., Ltd specializes in providing analytical solutions that include measurement, testing, and sample preparation for the semiconductor industry. Their expertise in spectroscopy and thermal analysis supports complex challenges faced in semiconductor manufacturing and research.

regional_presence.China: PerkinElmer has a significant presence in China, focusing on providing advanced analytical solutions to local semiconductor manufacturers.
